scope: IBM i PTF verification screens for transport-free IronTerm scenarios

sourcePolicy.tierA: IBM documentation, IBM Support technote, IBM Redbook, or clean IBM i capture
sourcePolicy.tierB: Legacy Control Lab implementation already accepted as a synthetic training screen
sourcePolicy.releaseRule: A fixture may not be enabled until labels, options, columns, status vocabulary, function keys, and navigation are supported by Tier A evidence and reviewed by John Flack.
sourcePolicy.dataRule: System names, PTF identifiers, products, releases, dates, group levels, and descriptions in shipped fixtures must be synthetic or public IBM examples.

legacyControlLab.role: Structural starting point only; LCL screens do not bypass Tier A validation.

screens.title: Work with PTF Groups
screens.lclAssessment: Reuse the LCL screen structure and subfile routing, then correct its option legend, group-level presentation, conditional keys, and release examples against IBM evidence.
confirmedBehavior: Displays PTF groups on the system
Supports PTFGRP(*ALL) and PTFGRPLVL(*INSTALLED|*LATEST|*ALL|1-99999)
Shows group status, group level, and target release
Option 5 displays a selected PTF group
Option 8 displays special-handling PTFs for the cumulative group
Option 4 deletes group information without deleting constituent PTFs
Multiple stored levels may appear
F6 prints the group report
